reason: I already take magnesium at night at home and I travel only twice a month, so I don't need it packed to go. The lab report and named lab are nice, but I'd just keep buying my usual bottle.
objection: I already have a magnesium I trust and take at home. The sachet convenience solves a problem I barely have, and I'd be paying more per day for the packaging.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the actual lab report with the named lab and a per-day price clearly below what I pay for my current bottle, plus a small trial size for travel days only.
